nt_tickers = [d["ticker"] for d in output_data["no_trade_decisions"]]
assert len(dec_tickers) == len(set(dec_tickers)), "Duplicate in decisions"
assert len(nt_tickers) == len(set(nt_tickers)), "Duplicate in no_trade_decisions"
assert set(dec_tickers).isdisjoint(set(nt_tickers)), "Overlap between decisions and no_trade"

# Check holdings coverage
covered_holdings = (set(dec_tickers) & set(holdings.keys())) | set(nt_tickers)
assert covered_holdings == set(holdings.keys()), f"Holdings mismatch: {set(holdings.keys()) ^ covered_holdings}"

# Check new buys not in holdings
for d in output_data["decisions"]:
    t = d["ticker"]
    act = d["action"]
    tw = d["target_weight"]
    assert len(d["risk_check"]) <= 300, f"risk_check too long: {d['decision_id']}"
    if act == "BUY":
        assert t not in holdings
        assert 0 < tw <= 0.10
        assert d["funding_for"] is None
    elif act == "ADD":
        assert t in holdings
        assert holdings[t]["tradable_weight"] < tw <= (0.25 if t == "2330" else 0.10)
        assert d["funding_for"] is None
    elif act == "TRIM":
        assert t in holdings
        assert 0 < tw < holdings[t]["tradable_weight"]
        assert tw <= (0.25 if t == "2330" else 0.10)
    elif act == "SELL_ALL":
        assert t in holdings
        assert tw == 0.0

# Check funding_for references
buy_add_ids = {d["decision_id"] for d in output_data["decisions"] if d["action"] in ("BUY", "ADD")}
for d in output_data["decisions"]:
    if d["funding_for"] is not None:
        assert d["action"] in ("TRIM", "SELL_ALL")
        for ref_id in d["funding_for"]:
            assert ref_id in buy_add_ids, f"Invalid funding_for {ref_id}"

for nt in output_data["no_trade_decisions"]:
    assert len(nt["reason"]) <= 300

final_count = sum(1 for d in output_data["decisions"] if d["target_weight"] > 0) + len(output_data["no_trade_decisions"])

est_cash_pct = 1.0 - total_tw
